subject: Q3 ops sync: roadmap trajectory, launch readiness & escalations
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Q3 ops sync: roadmap trajectory, launch readiness & escalations

Team —

Ahead of the QBR next week I ran a quick consolidation of product + engineering readiness for the three launches we committed to for early Q3. High level summary below; attaching the mitigation plan and the OKR checklist for reference. Please review and flag any gaps by EOD Friday.

1) Inference API v2 (public / hosted): on track for 2026-07-15 but we have two delivery risks that could impact the launch window:
  - Kernel regression in quantized path (impact: 95th perc latency +20%).
  - Integration testing with caching layer shows intermittent KV-stale during bursts.

2) Dedicated GPU autoscaler: target release 2026-07-22 — currently delayed by CI flakiness on the autoscaler e2e. Dev has a mitigation but it needs validation at scale.

3) Private/VPC installer (pilot): pilot delivery 2026-08-05; dependency on AcmeCloud partner for network peering docs — Laura is coordinating.

Key asks / decisions needed:
  - Dev: confirm ETA for the kernel rollback path vs a hotfix (I need a decision by 6/22 so we can lock the canary window).
  - Markus: draft a rollback + emergency runbook for the quantized path (include observability hooks and SLO escape clauses).
  - Laura: confirm Acme peering milestone and any procurement blockers.

Risks (short matrix):
  - High: kernel regression (probable impact to SLAs), Mitigation: canary + fallback to float32 variant.
  - Medium: autoscaler e2e flakiness (mitigation: scaled soak test + circuit breaker).

Attachments: launch_mitigations_v2.pdf (pdf), okr-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

I'll synthesize replies into the QBR slide deck on Monday.

Thanks —
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-21T10:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 ops sync: roadmap trajectory, launch readiness & escalations

On Mon, Jun 21, 2026 at 9:12 AM Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team —
>
> Ahead of the QBR next week I ran a quick consolidation of product + engineering readiness...

Thanks for the summary. Quick updates from infra/rt: we reproduced the kernel regression locally when running the new fused attention kernel under sequence lengths > 1024. Root cause points at a radix optimization in the kernel selector.

Options and rough ETAs (engineering estimate):
  - Full rollback to previous fused kernels (safe): 3 business days to stabilize + 1 day canary = ETA 2026-06-25 for canary start.
  - Patch to kernel selector (targeted fix): 5 business days + 2 days canary = ETA 2026-06-29 for production rollout.

I recommend rollback for the hosted API launch to preserve latency SLOs and follow with the selector fix in the next minor. I'll upload a short patch-plan.

Attachment: patch-plan.md

Dev
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-22T14:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 ops sync: roadmap trajectory, launch readiness & escalations

Evelyn / Dev —

Thanks Dev — rollback aligns with my read. A couple of operational asks if we go rollback route:
  - Runbook: I need a documented rollback procedure + checklist for on-call (DB migrations? config flips?). ETA: I can have a first draft by 6/23 COB.
  - Canary policy: define percentage buckets (5%, 20%, 100%) and an automated fallback that re-routes to float32 variant when latency breach > 10% sustained for 3 minutes.
  - Telemetry: add a token-level latency histogram so we can quickly isolate model sizes causing the regression.

I'll put the runbook in the Drive link and update the canary policy page. Also, autoscaler soak: recommend a 48-hour soak test in staging with synthetic burst traffic and an SLA guardrail of 99.5% pod-start success.

Markus
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acmecloud.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: acme-procurement@acmecloud.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-23T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Q3 ops sync: roadmap trajectory, launch readiness & escalations

Hi Sarah — forwarding our internal summary so you have visibility on the pilot timeline and the peering dependency. Short ask: can Acme provide the peering config and expected lead time for legal/procurement? We are targeting a pilot on 2026-08-05 and need the config by 2026-07-10 to avoid schedule slippage.

Please confirm and copy procurement on responses.

Laura
Product Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: Q3 ops sync: roadmap trajectory, launch readiness & escalations — consolidated decisions

Team — quick consolidated update for the QBR slides after reading everyone's inputs: 

Decisions (final):
  - Hosted Inference API v2: ship with rollback to prior fused kernels. Canary start 2026-06-25 (5% -> 20% -> 100%). Post-launch selector fix scheduled for 2026-07-01.
  - Dedicated autoscaler: proceed with 48-hour soak in staging starting 2026-06-26. If pod-start success < 99.5% after soak, we delay GA by one sprint and notify Sales.
  - Private/VPC pilot: Laura to confirm Acme peering config by 2026-07-10. If missing, pilot slips and we notify the partner success team.

Owners & next steps:
  - Dev: execute rollback canary plan and open a short retro ticket for the selector fix (JIRA-RED-4123).
  - Markus: publish rollback runbook and canary policy (link updated in Drive).
  - Laura: confirm partner timeline and escalate procurement blockers to Sarah / her team.

I've updated the QBR deck with these decisions and included the mitigation appendix (link below). Please review the deck and flag anything I missed by EOD 6/25 — I'll present this during leadership.

Deck link: https://drive.redwood.ai/teams/product/Q3-launch-mitigations
Jira: JIRA-RED-4123

Thanks all —
Evelyn
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
